message: You know that feeling when you finally get your act together? That was me last week! I spent an afternoon checking all the smoke alarms in my house—let me tell you, it was about time. I even tested our escape plan with the kids, and we had the best time pretending to be fire-fighters. 🔥 It felt great to be the one prepared for once! Just goes to show that a little readiness can spark some fun moments too. Have you checked your smoke alarms lately?
